arxiv-2102-04646.title: Stability Implies Robust Convergence of a Class of Preconditioned Parallel-in-time Iterative Algorithms
arxiv-2102-04646.creator: Shu-Lin Wu, Tao Zhou, Zhi Zhou
arxiv-2102-04646.description: Abstract Solving evolutionary equations in a parallel-in-time manner is an attractive topic and many algorithms are proposed in recent two decades. The algorithm based on the block α \alpha -circulant preconditioning technique has shown promising advantages, especially for wave propagation problems.

arxiv-2105-14323.title: Do we need to use regularization on the thermal part in the NJL model?
arxiv-2105-14323.creator: Kai Xue, Xiaozhu Yu, Xinyang Wang
arxiv-2105-14323.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kai Xue, Xiaozhu Yu, Xinyang Wang. The Nambu–Jona-Lasinio (NJL) model is one of the most useful tools to study non-perturbative strong interaction matter. Because it is a nonrenormalizable model, the choosing of regularization is a subtle issue. In this paper, we discuss one of the general things of the regularization in the NJL model, which is whether we need to use the regularization on the thermal part by evaluating the quark chiral condensate and thermal properties in the two-flavor NJL model.

arxiv-2202-12804.title: Hadronization and Color Transparency
arxiv-2202-12804.creator: Kai Gallmeister and Ulrich Mosel
arxiv-2202-12804.description: Abstract In this article we review our work on the production of hadrons in the nuclear environment. We work with a string-breaking model for the initial production of hadrons and with a quantum-kinetic transport model (GiBUU) to describe the final state interactions of the newly formed (pre)hadrons.

arxiv-2303-16181.title: Learning Federated Visual Prompt in Null Space for MRI Reconstruction
arxiv-2303-16181.creator: Chun-Mei Feng, Bangjun Li, Xinxing Xu, Yong Liu, Huazhu Fu, Wangmeng Zuo
arxiv-2303-16181.description: Abstract Federated Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) reconstruction enables multiple hospitals to collaborate distributedly without aggregating local data, thereby protecting patient privacy. However, the data heterogeneity caused by different MRI protocols, insufficient local training data, and limited communication bandwidth inevitably impair global model convergence and updating.

arxiv-2305-14343.title: Video Prediction Models as Rewards for Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2305-14343.creator: Alejandro Escontrela † Ademi Adeniji † Wilson Yan † Ajay Jain Xue Bin Peng Ken Goldberg Youngwoon Lee Danijar Hafner Pieter Abbeel University of California, Berkeley † Equal contribution
arxiv-2305-14343.description: Abstract Specifying reward signals that allow agents to learn complex behaviors is a long-standing challenge in reinforcement learning. A promising approach is to extract preferences for behaviors from unlabeled videos, which are widely available on the internet. We present Video Prediction Rewards (VIPER), an algorithm that leverages pretrained video prediction models as action-free reward signals for reinforcement learning.

arxiv-2307-04234.title: Extreme N-emitters at high-redshift: signatures of supermassive stars and globular cluster or black hole formation in action ?
arxiv-2307-04234.creator: R. Marques-Chaves, D. Schaerer, A. Kuruvanthodi, D. Korber, N. Prantzos, C. Charbonnel, A. Weibel, Y. I. Izotov, M. Messa, G. Brammer, M. Dessauges-Zavadsky, P. Oesch
arxiv-2307-04234.description: Abstract Context. Recent JWST spectroscopic observations of the z = 10.6 z=10.6 galaxy GN-z11 have revealed a very peculiar UV spectrum showing intense emission lines of nitrogen, which are generally not detected in galaxy spectra. This observation indicates a super-solar N/O abundance ratio at low metallicity, resembling only the abundances seen in globular cluster (GC) stars.

arxiv-2402-14646.title: CoLoRA: Continuous Low-Rank Adaptation for Reduced Implicit Neural Modeling of Parameterized Partial Differential Equations
arxiv-2402-14646.creator: Jules Berman, Benjamin Peherstorfer
arxiv-2402-14646.description: Abstract This work introduces reduced models based on Continuous Low Rank Adaptation (CoLoRA) that pre-train neural networks for a given partial differential equation and then continuously adapt low-rank weights in time to rapidly predict the evolution of solution fields at new physics parameters and new initial conditions.

arxiv-2411-11308.title: Uncovering the role of semantic and acoustic cues in normal and dichotic listening
arxiv-2411-11308.creator: Sai Samrat Kankanala, Akshara Soman, Sriram Ganapathy
arxiv-2411-11308.description: Abstract Speech comprehension is an involuntary task for the healthy human brain, yet the understanding of the mechanisms underlying this brain functionality remains obscure. In this paper, we aim to quantify the role of acoustic and semantic information streams in complex listening conditions.

arxiv-2502-20411.title: Backpropagation-free Spiking Neural Networks with the Forward-Forward Algorithm
arxiv-2502-20411.creator: Mohammadnavid Ghader, Saeed Reza Kheradpisheh, Bahar Farahani, Mahmood Fazlali
arxiv-2502-20411.description: Abstract Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer a biologically inspired computational paradigm that emulates neuronal activity through discrete spike-based processing. Despite their advantages, training SNNs with traditional backpropagation (BP) remains challenging due to computational inefficiencies and a lack of biological plausibility. This study explores the Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm as an alternative learning framework for SNNs.

arxiv-2503-00900.title: S4M: S4 for multivariate time series forecasting with M issing values
arxiv-2503-00900.creator: Jing Peng, Meiqi Yang, Qiong Zhang, Xiaoxiao Li
arxiv-2503-00900.description: Abstract Multivariate time series data play a pivotal role in a wide range of real-world applications, such as finance, healthcare, and meteorology, where accurate forecasting is critical for informed decision-making and proactive interventions. However, the presence of block missing data introduces significant challenges, often compromising the performance of predictive models.

arxiv-2503-08706.creator: S. Ali, A. Ahmidouch, G.R. Ambrose, A. Asaturyan, C. Ayerbe Gayoso, J. Benesch, V. Berdnikov, H. Bhatt, D. Bhetuwal, D. Biswas, P. Brindza, M. Bukhari, M. Burton, R. arxiv-2503-08706.description: Abstract The Super High Momentum Spectrometer (SHMS) has been built for Hall C at the Thomas Jefferson National Accelerator Facility (Jefferson Lab). With a momentum capability reaching 11 GeV/ c c , the SHMS provides measurements of charged particles produced in electron-scattering experiments using the maximum available beam energy from the upgraded Jefferson Lab accelerator.

arxiv-2510-26535.title: From dual gauge theories to dual spin models
arxiv-2510-26535.creator: Mustafa Mullahasanoglu
arxiv-2510-26535.description: Abstract This brief review surveys recent progress driven by the gauge/Yang-Baxter equation (YBE) correspondence. This connection has proven to be a powerful tool for discovering novel integrable lattice spin models in statistical mechanics by exploiting dualities in supersymmetric gauge theories.

arxiv-2601-21827.title: Late-time X-ray afterglows of GRBs: Implications for particle acceleration at relativistic shocks
arxiv-2601-21827.creator: Zhi-Qiu Huang, Om Sharan Salafia, Lara Nava, Annalisa Celotti, Giancarlo Ghirlanda
arxiv-2601-21827.description: Abstract Particle-in-cell (PIC) numerical simulations are currently among the most advanced tools to investigate particle acceleration at relativistic shocks. Still, they come with limitations imposed by finite computing power, whose impact is not straightforward to evaluate a priori. Observational features are hence required as verification.

pmc-10709416.title: A naturally occurring polyacetylene isolated from carrots promotes health and delays signatures of aging
pmc-10709416.creator: Carolin Thomas, Reto Erni, Jia Yee Wu, Fabian Fischer, Greta Lamers, Giovanna Grigolon, Sarah J. Mitchell, Kim Zarse, Erick M. Carreira, Michael Ristow

pmc-11414025.title: A transformative solution to build effective, transparent, and resilient “fit-for-purpose” national health research ethics systems
pmc-11414025.creator: Manju Rani, Neha Chawla, Nitya Wadhwa, Roli Mathur, Timothy Jinks, Priyanka Das, Suman Rijal
pmc-11414025.description: The current research ethics review systems are composed of isolated institutional Research Ethics Committees (RECs) that develop their own standard operating procedures (SOPs), templates and so on, with low adoption of digital solutions to manage submission and review processes. This poses several challenges, such as delays, higher costs, and hindering multi-site research.

pmc-11455927.title: Comparative analysis of the influence of BpfA and BpfG on biofilm development and current density in Shewanella oneidensis under oxic, fumarate- and anode-respiring conditions
pmc-11455927.creator: Edina Marlen Klein, Hannah Heintz, René Wurst, Simon Schuldt, Hendrik Hähl, Karin Jacobs, Johannes Gescher
pmc-11455927.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Biofilm formation by Shewanella oneidensis has been extensively studied under oxic conditions; however, relatively little is known about biofilm formation under anoxic conditions and how biofilm architecture and composition can positively influence current generation in bioelectrochemical systems. In this study, we utilized a recently developed microfluidic biofilm analysis setup with automated 3D imaging to investigate the effects of extracellular electron acceptors and synthetic modifications to the extracellular polymeric matrix on biofilm formation.

pmc-11603441.title: Combined Anterior Cruciate Ligament and Anterior Oblique Ligament Reconstruction Using the Rectus Femoris Tendon: Surgical Technique Description

Objectives:Present a combined anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) and anterior oblique ligament (AOL) reconstruction technique using a rectus femoris tendon graft harvested in a minimally invasive approach.Methods:Examination under anesthesia should confirm ACL insufficiency and associated anteromedial rotational instability. The graft is harvested from the lateral portion of the rectus femoris tendon using a closed tendon stripper with the knee at 20 degrees of flexion.

pmc-12605736.description: In plants, peptides play an irreplaceable role as intercellular communication molecules, triggering signal transduction by activating plasma membrane-localized receptors. pmc-12615676.description: Chryseobacterium spp. are Gram-negative, opportunistic pathogens antibiotic-resistant commonly found in the environment. Between June and July 2023, six cases of infection with Chryseobacterium spp. were identified in a hospital in Apulia, southern Italy.

pmc-12710096.creator: Arvindran Alaga, Izzatul Nadzirah Ismail
pmc-12710096.description: There remains a paucity of evidence from Asia on the cost‐effectiveness of biologics for severe asthma. This pilot cost‐offset analysis aims to evaluate the economic impact of adding biologics (omalizumab or benralizumab) to severe asthma standard care as a proof of concept for its cost‐effectiveness, and to assess improvement in exacerbation rates and asthma control.

pmc-12932384.title: Environmental effects on mineral supplement intake in grazing Nellore heifers under tropical conditions

pmc-12963236.title: 3D-printed hip prostheses with regenerative integration: a state-of-the-art comprehensive review
pmc-12963236.creator: Sebastián Giraldo Gallego, Luis Eduardo Rodríguez Cheu
pmc-12963236.description: This article offers an in-depth review of the design and modeling of 3D-printed hip prostheses, emphasizing the integration of regenerative medicine, especially in the context of custom Rapidly Destructive Osteoarthritis implants. It traces the history of Total hip arthroplasty and current implant materials, along with recent advances in tissue engineering strategies and biofunctionalization methods to enhance biological integration.

pmc-12966921.description: IntroductionPrimary mediastinal non‐seminomatous germ cell tumors (PMNSGCTs) are rare and aggressive neoplasms that carry a poor prognosis, especially following salvage chemotherapy. pmc-13146944.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1615 MECHANICAL THROMBECTOMY IN ACUTE ISCHEMIC STROKE IN VERY ANCIENT PATIENTS (≥90 YEARS OLD): EXPERIENCE IN 39 PATIENTS IN A LARGE TERTIARY CARE CENTRE

pmc-13146944.description: Background and aimsMechanical thrombectomy has revolutionized the treatment of acute ischemic stroke due to large vessel occlusion, demonstrating functional benefit without a significant increase in mortality. However, there are no randomized controlled trials in patients older than 90 years, and the available evidence derives from studies with lower levels of scientific evidence.

pmc-13148599.title: Absolute scaling of small- and wide-angle X-ray scattering images recorded with short duration X-ray pulses on a large area fiber-taper X-ray detector
pmc-13148599.creator: Hyun Sun Cho, Friedrich Schotte, Robert Henning, Philip A. Anfinrud
pmc-13148599.description: An X-ray scattering setup designed to capture small- and wide-angle X-ray scattering on a single, large area detector features a partially transmissive beamstop that facilitates non-invasive recording of X-ray beam position and intensity during acquisition of X-ray scattering images. The integrated transmitted intensity allows different datasets to be put on the same absolute scale and thereby achieve accurate differencing.

pmc-13233581.title: Trends in utilization of an anonymous abortion and miscarriage hotline before and after Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13233581.creator: Sara K Redd, Alexandra A Gavidia, Taylor Jones, Sage Dillon, Alina A Luke, Emma Chew Murphy, Marissa J Arzate, Ashley Martinez, Mindy Brittner, April Lockley, Whitney Rice, Jennifer Karlin
pmc-13233581.description: SummaryBackgroundThe Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization decision significantly altered abortion access in the U.S., increasing reliance on resources outside the formal healthcare system. This study examined utilization of a medical hotline supporting people managing their abortions and miscarriages, comparing trends before and after Dobbs.

pmc-13312352.title: Investigation of an ongoing cluster of tuberculosis (TB) associated with prisons, England
pmc-13312352.creator: Lucy Findlater, Mailis Maes, Nathan Post, Amith Philip, Lauren Ahyow, Chantal Edge, Martin Dedicoat, Tracey Langham, Suzi Coles, Esther Robinson
pmc-13312352.description: Prisons are high-risk environments for the spread of tuberculosis (TB). We investigated an ongoing prison-associated TB cluster to identify common exposures. We defined cases as residents in England with laboratory-confirmed TB belonging to the genetic cluster. We extracted records from the National TB Surveillance System, linked to prison operational data, and conducted descriptive analysis of demographic, clinical, and phylogenetic data.
